feature.description: Generate a minimal backend feature library at libs/backend/features/<name>.

entity.description: Generate a Mongo-backed backend entity library at libs/backend/features/<name>, with an optional REST controller (--crud) and an optional shared contract + lazy frontend feature (--frontend).

frontend-feature.description: Generate a lazy-loaded business feature under the /app shell (signals store, typed HTTP service, list + detail pages), wired via loadChildren + a DASHBOARD_NAV entry.
